data.narrative:
Persona AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Nic Radford and Jerry Pratt that has raised $25M to date. The robotics and manufacturing sector includes a broader peer universe of 9 private and 1 public comparable company, though a narrowly filtered peer set at identical stage and valuation tier yielded insufficient datapoints for robust median-based valuation.

Given the absence of a sufficient peer cohort at the same stage and tier, stage-progression methodology was applied as the primary valuation lever. Using total capital raised as a proxy valuation base, a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A advancement yields an implied value of $62.5M. This method treats the $25M deployed as a floor-level capitalization and applies standard venture progression rates to estimate post-Seed valuation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $53M (low) to $72M (high), centered on $62.5M (median). The wide range reflects the single-method triangulation and limited comparable granularity at Persona AI's specific stage and sector intersection. Primary uncertainties include the availability of additional same-stage robotics peers for cross-validation and the applicability of standard step-up multiples to the frontier-robotics subsector, where stage duration and capital efficiency may diverge from median venture patterns.
